text_en: Evening. Got a room for one night?
Been walking since dawn. I'm done in.
Just call me a traveler. Names don't buy much out here.
text_ko: 그냥 나그네라고 부르세요. 이런 데선 이름 따위 쓸모없으니까.

text_en: Somewhere the road stops. You know any place like that?
text_ko: 길이 끝나는 곳 어딘가로요. 그런 데 아세요?

text_en: Yeah. Figured as much.
Fair enough. Lead the way.
No room? After all that walking?
I won't be trouble. Gone by first light.
...Fine. I've slept in worse than a ditch.
Thank you. You won't hear a sound from me.
What do you want at this hour?

label_en: Ask about the noise last night
text_en: Noise? I was asleep the whole time.
Ah - yes. Hello. A room. Please. Just the one.
text_ko: 아 - 네. 안녕하세요. 방이요. 부탁드립니다. 하나면 됩니다.

text_en: Long day. Very long. You have no idea.
text_ko: 긴 하루였어요. 아주 길었죠. 상상도 못 하실 겁니다.

text_en: Samples! Brushes mostly. Nothing you'd want. Nothing at all.
text_ko: 견본입니다! 대부분 솔이에요. 탐나실 만한 건 없어요. 전혀요.

text_en: Cold out. That's all. Just the cold.
text_ko: 밖이 추워서요. 그게 다입니다. 그냥 추위 때문이에요.

text_en: I said it's the cold! Are we done here?
No? Please. I can pay double.
text_ko: 안 된다고요? 제발요. 두 배로 내겠습니다.

text_en: Where else is open? Nowhere. You know that.
text_ko: 다른 데가 어디 열었겠어요? 없어요. 아시잖아요.

text_en: This is a mistake. You'll see.
Fine. FINE. I'm going.
Oh thank you. You won't even know I'm here.
text_ko: 아 감사합니다. 있는 줄도 모르실 거예요.

text_en: Same as always. Key. Now.
You're slow tonight. Move it.

label_en: Ask him to wait a moment
text_en: I don't wait. That's your job.
text_ko: 난 안 기다려. 그게 네 일이잖아.

text_en: You've seen my face a hundred times.
Here. Happy? Don't lose it this time.
Excuse me?
You do NOT turn me away. Not me.
You'll regret this. Count on it.
Finally.
A room. Away from the road if you have one.
text_ko: 방 하나요. 가능하면 길에서 먼 쪽으로.

label_en: Ask why away from the road
text_en: I sleep lighter than most.
Is that a requirement?
...Yes. Alone.
That's my business. Not yours.
text_ko: 그건 제 일이에요. 당신 일이 아니라.

text_en: I see.
I'll find somewhere. I always do.
Good. Don't knock after dark.
Evening evening! Cold one out there tonight isn't it?
text_ko: 안녕하세요 안녕하세요! 오늘 밤 바깥 꽤 춥죠?

text_en: Room for an old man's bones?
text_ko: 늙은이 뼈 하나 뉠 방 있겠소?

text_en: Oh it's a long story. Which part do you want?
text_ko: 아, 긴 이야기라오. 어느 대목이 궁금하시오?

text_en: It started forty years back in a town that isn't on the maps anymore...
text_ko: 사십 년 전, 이제는 지도에도 없는 마을에서 시작됐다오...

text_en: Visiting family. Or what's left of them.
Storm's coming. Mark my words. Sky goes green first.
text_ko: 폭풍이 오고 있소. 내 말 명심하시오. 하늘부터 초록빛으로 변한다오.

text_en: Kind of you to ask.
Bless you. These old knees will thank you.
text_ko: 고맙기도 하지. 이 늙은 무릎이 고마워할 거요.

text_en: I wouldn't say no to that.
Oh. Oh dear. On a night like this?
I don't move so fast anymore. Have a heart.
...Alright. Sorry to have troubled you.
Bless you son. Sleep well now.
